subject: Proposal: Eval credit offer for MedTech Labs RFP
messages:
From: Alice Novak <alice@medtechlabs.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@medtechlabs.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP: Side-by-side benchmark + logistics

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking the time on the intro call yesterday. As I mentioned, MedTech Labs is running a tight RFP with three vendors for a week-long side-by-side benchmark focused on inference latency, cost, and hallucination rate on our clinical summarization use case. The RFP (attached) outlines the evaluation criteria, data samples, and timeline.

Two quick asks: can Redwood provide an evaluation credit pool for an isolated benchmark (we'd prefer consumption-based credits rather than account credits), and are you open to a 60-day evaluation window? Also, we have a standard confidentiality appendix — happy to share.

Best,
Alice
Director, Platform Engineering
MedTech Labs
[Attachment: MedTech_RFP_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alice Novak <alice@medtechlabs.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@medtechlabs.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP: Side-by-side benchmark + logistics

Hi Alice — great to hear the RFP landed. Appreciate the details.

We can absolutely support a competitive bake-off. High-level proposal from our side:
- Conditional evaluation credit equivalent to ~300k tokens for benchmark runs (we can express as dollar equivalent if you prefer)
- 45-day evaluation window starting on first test run (we can extend to 60 days if contractually committed/shortlist confirmed)
- Consumption limited to the test datasets you provided; credits revoked if used beyond benchmarking scope
- Security questionnaire: we require completion of our standard security addendum and SSO/KMS gating before broad data ingestion

If MedTech confirms Redwood as a finalist within your shortlist, we can discuss a top-up (additional credits) and a short operational SLA for the pilot. Please let me know if that meets you half-way; if so I will loop in our finance/ops for formal sign-off and DocuSign.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0192

[Related link: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/security/questionnaire]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: RFP: Side-by-side benchmark + logistics — approval request

Folks — forwarding MedTech's RFP and the ask. They want a consumption-style evaluation pool for a one-week side-by-side with a requested 60-day window. I proposed a conditional 300k-token equivalent with a 45-day baseline and top-up if shortlisted.

Specific approvals needed:
- Finance: confirm we can authorize a 300k-token credit against the MDF/eval budget and how to book it (promotion vs credit adjustment)
- Legal: quick review of confidentiality appendix and our security addendum
- Ops: confirm we can enforce dataset scope (prefix caching exclusions) and set consumption cap on the project ID

Attaching the RFP and a usage template I use for bake-offs. If we want to be competitive, I think a modest top-up for finalists is reasonable, but leaning toward keeping the initial pool conservative.

Thanks,
Evelyn

[Attachment: usage_template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFP: Side-by-side benchmark + logistics — approval request

Thanks for the context, Evelyn. I'm supportive but want tighter guardrails:
- Approve 300k-token credit (as proposed) from the Q2 eval budget. Book to deal DL-2026-1743 and include a one-line note: "benchmark stipend — MedTech Labs".
- Limit evaluation window to 45 days unless MedTech confirms Redwood is a top-3 finalist in writing, then auto-approve a 15-day top-up (no more than +150k tokens).
- Require HubSpot deal record and ops ticket (OPS-442) before credits are provisioned.
- Legal to execute our standard NDA addendum and security questionnaire before any data upload; Ops will enforce throughput caps.

Ben — loop finance to allocate the funds; Chloe — please create the OPS ticket and set project-level consumption caps. Evelyn — once legal signs off, you can send the DocuSign pilot agreement template to the prospect.

Marissa
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alice Novak <alice@medtechlabs.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@medtechlabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP: Side-by-side benchmark + logistics

Hi Alice — quick update and next steps.

Per internal approvals, we can commit the following:
- Provision 300k-token evaluation credit scoped to the RFP test dataset.
- Evaluation window: 45 days from the provisioning date. If you confirm Redwood as a top-3 finalist in writing within that window, we'll automatically unlock an incremental 150k-token top-up and extend the window by 15 days.
- Pre-reqs: completed security questionnaire and signed addendum (link below). Ops will create a project ID with enforced consumption caps and prefix exclusions.

Please review the terms and confirm whether MedTech will include Redwood in the shortlist criteria. If yes, I will send the DocuSign pilot agreement (one-click acceptance) and schedule a short ops handoff call with our solutions engineer.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm shortlist status/intent by reply (this triggers the 60-day consideration).
2) Complete security questionnaire: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/security/questionnaire
3) Accept DocuSign pilot agreement (I will send after your confirmation).

Thank you — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[DocuSign placeholder: https://docusign.net/pilot/DL-2026-1743]
